thread:
Amelia (Partnerships): Heads-up team: were starting the publisher onboarding flow for AWS/GCP/Azure today. Goal: get images notarized, SKUs mapped to billing plans, and staging listing validation all green by Friday. Main risks: image signing + VAT/tax metadata.

Diego (Marketplace): I'll drive the publisher portal checklist. Need the signed image artifacts and a contact email for the publisher account. Also ask: does GCP require container images or VM images for their catalog?

Priya (Product): Product wants two SKUs: basic (single-node metered) and dedicated (reserved instance). Basic will have metered tokens; dedicated will be a flat monthly charge. I'll post pricing tiers shortly. Also need a one-line tagline and 1 feature gif.

Lena (Security): Security note: marketplace requires image signing (cosign) + SBOM for images. We need to run the vulnerability scan and attach a signed SBOM. Can Vulnerability team run a quick scan on the AMI/container and produce an attestation?

Vik (Infra): We can produce signed images. Plan: build in CI, sign with cosign key in KMS, upload to S3/GCR/ACR, publish checksum. Example artifact path: gs://rdw-marketplace/images/rdw-2026-ami.tar.gz sha256: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e. Will replace placeholder after build.

Diego (Marketplace): GCP prefers container images (GCR) for marketplace listings. AWS/Azure accept AMIs/VM images. We'll need both if we want cross-cloud parity.

Priya (Product): Ok let's do a container image for GCP and AMI for AWS/Azure. For trial rules: trial access should be 30 days or 500k tokens, whichever comes first. Also add a 14-day credit grace for existing customers.

Lena (Security): I'll kick off OSS vuln scan and SBOM generation. @Vik please ensure the build pipeline emits sbom.json and cosign-signed dist.

Vik (Infra): On it. Pushing a minimal pipeline snippet to CI: 
```
steps:
  - build: build-image.sh
  - sbom: syft . -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json
  - sign: cosign sign --key ksm://projects/rdw/keys/cosign dist.tar.gz
```
Will post the full pipeline in #eng-infra.

Diego (Marketplace): Also need tax metadata: VAT classification, VAT inclusive prices for EU. Finance wants SKU tax code for each SKU. @Priya can you confirm pricing in EUR/GBP?

Priya (Product): Draft pricing: Basic $0.02 per 1k tokens, Dedicated $2,500/month. EUR/GBP equivalents: will provide by EOD.

Amelia (Partnerships): Manual publisher sign-off: Azure listed a requirement for publisher verification which may be manual. If so we lose a day. Diego, can you open the publisher support ticket now so they flag it as expedited?

Diego (Marketplace): Opening ticket MP-511 now and marking expedited. Also attaching initial artifact manifest.

marketplace-bot: MP-511 created: https://internal.trackers/MP-511 (status: open)

Lena (Security): One more item: require proof of data residency wording for EU customers (we support EU regions). We'll add an FAQ bullet on the product page.

Vik (Infra): Noted. Also we need to confirm network inbound rules for the marketplace health check (port 443 outbound only). I'll confirm NAT ranges for staging and prod.

Priya (Product): I'll draft the short FAQ + billing text and share screenshots in #marketing.

Amelia (Partnerships): Action owners: Diego - open publisher ticket + portal checklist (owner), Vik - image signing + sbom pipeline + nat ranges (owner), Lena - vuln scan + attestation (owner), Priya - SKU pricing + copy + VAT mapping (owner). Sync tomorrow 09:00 PT for quick unblock. Thanks. :rocket:
